question: Why is time said to belong to the knowable rather than limit the knower?
premises: The knower is not conceptually limited.
Therefore the knower does not fall within the range of time.
The scriptures accordingly declare time to be a property of the knowable.
inference: Time cannot limit the knower and is instead classified as belonging to the knowable.
plain_english: Because the knower cannot be conceptually limited, he is not within the range of time; therefore the scriptures declare that time has the status of a property of the knowable.
